name: Shift and Vroom (online used cars)
title: Did Shift and Vroom fail on timing? No: Carvana grew
question: Were online used-car retailers like Shift and Vroom too early?
answer: Shift filed for bankruptcy in October 2023 and Vroom shut its e-commerce business in January 2024. Carvana sold used cars online through the same years, survived a near-death 2022-23, and grew again. Same market, same date: not a timing failure.
verdict_reason: Carvana sold cars online through the same period and grew.

constraint.name: Nothing was missing
constraint.detail: The enablers it needed already existed; something else killed it.

graveyard.how: Wound down its e-commerce operations, January 2024
